- 758.6 × 49 = 37,171.4; remainder 31.6; 31.6 / 758.6 = 0.041precisely 0.041657... So Millbrook ≈ 49.04166 → 49.042.

Comparison: Millbrook (49.042) is higher than Brightwater (48.486). Difference = 49.04166 − 48.48606 = 0.55560 → 0.556.

Answer: Millbrook is the higher-density district in 2025, by about 0.556 residents per km².
